entries.name: 세실리아
entries.description: Adult woman with elegant chestnut-brown hair in a loose low bun, side bangs, blue eyes, sapphire drop earrings and pendant. Ivory tailored blazer over navy collared blouse and navy knee-length pencil skirt, slim black waist belt. Both forearms and articulated gloves are sleek white-silver fantasy gauntlets with blue crystal cores as in reference; no gun. Add simple navy closed-toe office pumps to complete the lower body. Relaxed battle-ready stance, one armored fist slightly raised and the other near waist, both gauntlets fully visible.
entries.prompt:

Create ONE complete full-body stylized ADULT SD character, approximately 4 heads tall like input 2, elegant mature face with readable expressive eyes, adult body silhouette, polished Korean collectible RPG painterly shading and delicate outlines, rich yet clean separated cloth/metal/hair materials. Not photorealistic, 3D, toy, baby or child. Preserve reference 1's unique face, hairstyle, clothing structure, colors and entire weapon design; only simplify tiny ornament for small battle readability.

Entire hair, both hands, complete weapon tips and both feet visible inside canvas with clear margins of at least 3%. Feet near 94% canvas height and on same ground level. Weapon stays above feet ground-contact line. No backdrop, floor, scenery, pedestal, ground shadow, aura, particles, muzzle flash, text, frame, watermark, other character, solid background, gradient or baked checkerboard. This is an isolated transparent production sprite to overlay arbitrary battle backgrounds. Real alpha is mandatory.
